question: The President of which country was invited as a special guest in the first Republic Day parade held in the year 1950?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indonesia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The principal Republic Day March **was hung on 26 January 1950, during which the Leader of Indonesia Sukarno was the central visitor.
 
• Somewhere in the range of 1**950 and 1954**, Republic Day marches were held at Irwin Arena (presently Public Arena), Kingsway, Red Stronghold and Ramlila Maidan.
 
• Delegates from the Assembled Realm and France have been welcomed multiple times each.
 
• The principal Republic Day March was hung on 26 January 1950, drove by then **Brigadier Moti Sagar of the Gorkha Regiment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The constitution became effective two days after the fact, on** January 26, 1950. Dr Rajendra Prasad **started his most memorable residency as Leader of the Indian Association on that day.
 
• **For the 2021 Republic Day march,** UK Head of the state Boris Johnson was welcome to be the central visitor.
 
• **On October 1, 1949,** Mao Zedong, the head of the Red Armed force (socialist powers), formally pronounced the development of Individuals' Republic of China before a horde of 300,000 in Tiananmen Square while waving the recently made Chinese banner.
 
• Republic Day of Pakistan was first seen in** 1956** when Pakistan formally turned into a Republic and disregarded the previous status of Domini.
